title: The Frozen Waterfall
rumor: The Frozen Waterfall. During the deepest winter, a waterfall in the high mountains freezes into a great wall of blue ice. Behind it lies a cavern containing strangely preserved trees, animal bones, and objects from an age no one remembers. The cavern can reportedly be entered only while the falls are frozen.
first_lead: Highcairn hunters sometimes use the frozen waterfall as a seasonal landmark.
